real_world_friction_design.case_specific_friction: Public CL120 case friction focuses on the bounded patient-facing episode: caregiver_conflict_or_fatigue; secondary friction patterns include privacy_stigma_or_sensitive_history, incomplete_patient_information. The simulator should expose only clinically relevant patient/caregiver and care-system friction, without origin-record metadata.
real_world_friction_design.why_this_friction_is_realistic_for_this_: The simulated episode contains multi-document hospital evidence, staged results/orders, and care-transition context. Friction is intentionally bounded so the case remains closable under closure_contract_v2.
how_friction_should_surface: Opening actor provides an incomplete or practical-problem-oriented account rather than a full chart summary.
Workspace records are available but must be actively queried and interpreted.
Secondary frictions to surface only if clinically relevant: privacy_stigma_or_sensitive_history, incomplete_patient_information.
